name: JPL Small-Body Database (SBDB) API
summary: Orbital elements, physical parameters and discovery details for asteroids and comets, plus close-approach, fireball and Sentry APIs.
description: The SSD/CNEOS API suite exposes the Small-Body Database (over a million objects), close approach data, fireball events, Sentry impact risk, NHATS and orbit/ephemeris tools. Responses give orbital elements with uncertainties, diameter, albedo, rotation and NEO/PHA flags.

rate_limit.summary: No documented numeric limit; requests are serialized, so be polite.

agent_notes: Look up an object with sstr (name or designation) or spk (SPK-ID). No CORS header is sent, so call it from a server or proxy rather than browser JS.
caveats: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header, so not usable directly from browser JavaScript.
During research curl needed -k once due to a local certificate-chain issue in the sandbox; probably not a service problem.
